en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a weathered stone statue of a robed, possibly ecclesiastical figure standing on a small pedestal against a high rough-stone wall. The figure's face and some details are eroded, and it appears to be holding an object in front of its chest. The statue is set beside a descending stone pathway or stair with a handrail. In the distant upper left background faint outlines of hills or mountains are visible. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
